modules.title: Understanding Check: Topic Overview & Objectives
modules.script: Let's pause here for a quick concept check on Topic Overview & Objectives. In Python, what does `numbers[0]` access in the list `numbers = [10, 20, 30]`?

checkpoint_question.question_text: In Python, what does `numbers[0]` access in the list `numbers = [10, 20, 30]`?
checkpoint_question.prompt: In Python, what does `numbers[0]` access in the list `numbers = [10, 20, 30]`?
checkpoint_question.explanation: Python lists use zero-based indexing, so index 0 points to the very first item (10).

misconception_distractors.B: Assumed 1-based indexing where index 0 would be before the list.
misconception_distractors.D: Confused the index number with the stored value.
